environment.description: Service runs in a private subnet (10.0.4.0/24) behind an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer). The NLB target group has proxy protocol v2 disabled. Upstream traffic arrives only through an AWS PrivateLink endpoint whose endpoint policy restricts access to principals in accounts 111122223333 and 444455556666. Additionally, the VPC's subnet NACL has explicit DENY rules for all ingress except from three CIDR prefixes: 10.200.0.0/16 (corporate VPN egress), 172.16.88.0/22 (CI/CD runners), and 192.168.50.0/24 (monitoring fleet). The NLB listener has no public DNS; resolution is via Route53 private hosted zone (internal.sessions.corp) associated only with the two allowed VPCs. There is no internet gateway or NAT gateway in the service VPC, so even if an attacker discovers the IP, packets cannot route from the public internet. The security group on the NLB ENIs further restricts source to the same three CIDR ranges.

network.vpc: no IGW, no NAT-GW, isolated VPC

config.load_balancer: Internal NLB, no public DNS, Route53 private hosted zone
config.dns: internal.sessions.corp, associated with allowed VPCs only
